entries.not_relevant_because: The sole manuscript, 'Combinatorial invariance of Kazhdan--Lusztig polynomials', proves only that the equal-parameter P_{u,b}(q) is determined by the abstract Bruhat interval poset; it makes no statement about the values P_{y,w}(1), about representations (Verma modules, category O, characters or multiplicities), or about the positivity of KL coefficients, and its only link to the problem is that it concerns the same polynomials, which the matching pass itself called a separate conjecture.
